summary: Created the welcome-email test-design artifact with traceable cases for all planned stories and failure paths: Gmail sender configuration, new-registration trigger behavior, safe send-failure handling, duplicate welcome avoidance, and non-browser verification with mocked/injectable sender coverage. Evidence reviewed included the welcome-email requirements, prior registration implementation sources, Prisma schema, auth flow, registration actions, package dependencies, and Gmail env key names without exposing values. Checks run successfully: `npm.cmd ls next next-auth @auth/prisma-adapter @prisma/client prisma typescript --depth=0`, `npx.cmd prisma validate`, and `npx.cmd tsc --noEmit --incremental false`. Browser verification, Playwright, app server startup, deployment, publishing, and real Gmail delivery were not run per task constraints.
